C0244.title: Review Study on Machine Learning for Email Spam Filtering
C0244.summary: In 2019, Heliyon published "Machine learning for email spam filtering: review, approaches and open research problems." The paper reviews machine learning approaches, feature extraction, and classification evaluation for email spam filtering, and discusses dataset issues, adversarial changes, and open research problems in spam detection.
